name: Southwind Village
summary: Southwind Village is the haunted ruin of a night elf outpost located in the sands of Silithus. Wiped out by the qiraji during the War of the Shifting Sands, its streets are now bound by the restless spirits of fallen defenders and prowling silithid.

sections.title: A Tragedy in the Sands
sections.body: Southwind Village once served as a primary night elf stronghold during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands a thousand years ago. When the qiraji legions breached the defensive perimeter, Valstann Staghelm—son of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm—led a detachment to hold the village. The defense ended in utter disaster: the night elven defenders were overwhelmed and slaughtered, and Valstann himself was dragged away into captivity by General Rajaxx. The village was completely ruined, leaving its former buildings fractured under the sun.

sections.title: The Tormented Dead
sections.body: A millennium after its fall, Southwind Village remains an open wound in the desert. The trauma of the assault was so absolute that the spirits of the slain night elf Sentinels and druids could not move on. Driven mad by the horror of their final moments, these restless phantoms—led by the Shade of Ambermoon—endlessly roam the crumbled stone walls, lashing out at any who intrude while predatory silithid swarm the surrounding dunes.

faq.answer: Southwind Village was destroyed a thousand years ago during the War of the Shifting Sands. The ravenous qiraji army swarmed the night elven garrison, mercilessly butchering its defenders and flattening the outpost.

Valstann Staghelm was the beloved son of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. He led the desperate defense of Southwind Village against the invading insectoids, but his troops were decimated and he was captured by the qiraji commander, General Rajaxx.

faq.q: Why are there night elf ghosts here?
aliases: why are there ghosts in southwind
faq.answer: The sudden and brutal slaughter of the defenders trapped their souls in the ruins. The spirits of the slain druids and Sentinels are caught in an eternal loop of their final, terrifying battle, overseen by the lingering Shade of Ambermoon.

faq.q: Are the bugs related to what destroyed the village?
faq.answer: Yes. The silithid swarming around the ruins are part of the broader insectoid scourge tied to the qiraji, the very force that invaded Silithus and destroyed the outpost centuries ago.

angles.text: For night elves, Southwind Village represents one of the most agonizing defeats in their history, and the tortured specters wandering its broken masonry are fellow kaldorei awaiting peace.
The ruined grove-like structures and tormented spirits of ancient druids lingering in Southwind serve as a grim reminder of nature's loss against the insectoid hordes.
